settings.signIn.signInToChange: Sign in with your password to change this.
settings.signIn.confirmPlex: Confirm on the Plex page that opened. This waits up to 10 minutes.
settings.signIn.blocked: Plex window blocked. Allow pop-ups and try again.
settings.signIn.linkedPick: Linked. Close the Plex window, pick the server people must share, then Save.
settings.signIn.linkedNone: Linked. Close the Plex window; Plex lists no server you own.
settings.signIn.timedOut: The Plex sign-in timed out. Start again.
settings.signIn.confirmUnlink: Unlink Plex? People import stops working.
settings.signIn.whoShared: everyone your Plex server is shared with
settings.signIn.whoServer: everyone with an account on your {app} server
settings.signIn.everyoneText: This lets {who} make a HolyArrs account the first time they sign in{count}. They join as Members who may request titles.
settings.signIn.title: Sign-in and security
settings.signIn.shortestHint: 4 to 64 characters, for new passwords only
settings.signIn.shortWarn: Short passwords are easy to guess. HolyArrs slows down repeated wrong sign-ins, which helps, but it does not make a short password safe. If HolyArrs can be reached from outside your home, use 8 or more.
settings.signIn.adminsNote: An admin without it can open only My account until they turn it on. Anyone can turn it on for themselves in My account.
settings.signIn.onlyOwnerChange: Only the owner can change this.
settings.signIn.plexIntro: People sign in with their Plex account on Plex's own page; HolyArrs never sees their Plex password.
settings.signIn.otherIntro: People sign in with the name and password they use on your {app} server; HolyArrs checks them with the server and keeps neither.
settings.signIn.showButton: Show the {app} button on the sign-in page
settings.signIn.linkNote: Link Plex to pick your server and import its people
settings.signIn.serverIdHint: Only people it's shared with can join
settings.signIn.whoJoin: Who may join the first time
settings.signIn.joinHintPlex: New people join as Members. Plex managed users join as Kid (up to PG).
settings.signIn.joinList: Only the names or emails below
settings.signIn.joinEveryonePlex: Everyone with a Plex account (who shares the server, when set)
settings.signIn.joinEveryone: Everyone with an account on the {app} server
settings.signIn.names: Names or emails, one per line
settings.signIn.skipLocal: Skip sign-in on my local network
settings.signIn.skipNote: Devices on the networks below open HolyArrs as the owner, without a password. With family or friends on the same network, leave this off: they would get the owner's rights too.
settings.signIn.directOnly: Works only for direct visits. Using a proxy? Add it to trusted proxies.
settings.signIn.keysNeed: Keys and passwords still need a sign-in
settings.signIn.proxyA: A proxy in front of HolyArrs is not trusted, so sign-in is never skipped through it. Add the proxy's address to
settings.signIn.gatewayOne: {nets} looks like a Docker or Podman gateway address. If every device shows up as that address, anyone who can reach HolyArrs opens it as the owner. Check the address above from another device; if it is the same, turn off Skip sign-in, then remove this entry.
settings.signIn.gatewayMany: {nets} look like a Docker or Podman gateway address. If every device shows up as that address, anyone who can reach HolyArrs opens it as the owner. Check the address above from another device; if it is the same, turn off Skip sign-in, then remove this entry.
settings.signIn.apiKeysNote: Make and revoke them on the API page
settings.signIn.hostsHint: Names you open HolyArrs by besides its IP address, like tower.local or media.example.com. The name you used at first-run setup is already here. Names in HOLYARRS_ALLOWED_HOSTS always work and are not listed.
settings.signIn.proxiesHint: Set when HolyArrs starts, not here: list your reverse proxy addresses in HOLYARRS_TRUSTED_PROXIES and extra host names in HOLYARRS_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Without a proxy, nothing is needed.
settings.signIn.importIntro: Sign in once as an admin of your {app} server to list its people. HolyArrs ends that session right after and keeps neither the name nor the password.
settings.signIn.importNote: People join as Members. Kid is PG or lower. Server admins stay Members.
